claims.title: Kinetic completion gives sharp one-edge query rules with finite-precision extensions and exact adaptive counterexamples

status: Source claims plus separate internal advances; externally unreviewed.
interface: A specified finite reversible grounded graph with known positive masses m, known possible moves, independent conductance box l<=c<=u, and A(l)>0. Objective F=m^T A(c)^(-1)m or equilibrium-conditioned mean F/sum m. A query measures one microscopic conductance, with exact or explicitly valid interval uncertainty. State/edge enumeration, masses, bounds, calibration, rate acquisition, precision and checking remain paid.
limits: Review the endpoint/finite-precision proofs and prior art independently. Acquire a physically justified microscopic move alphabet, valid global bounds, mass/source coverage and calibrated rate intervals with measured costs. Develop a sound compressed extremal solver or continuous-outcome global policy only if it improves complete resources against the full sparse solver and structure-aware baselines. No rate query may silently assume discovered metastable gates.
